Authors' explanation (sec. 2.3-2.6): the 300 C dry treatments and RH-50 left the ~5-6 nm amorphous layer unchanged and v_cr ranges overlap; the five dry/control batches pooled give 836 +- 12 m/s. RH-95 alone thickened the layer (~8 nm, +2-3 nm), formed crystalline (oxy)hydroxide pockets and OH bonds; desiccation removed OH and crystallinity and lowered v_cr, pointing to hydroxide chemistry. No significant post-mortem difference between As-Recd and RH-95 impacts.
